blocks.content: Quiz: How do you link an external CSS file to your HTML document?

By using the <style> tag.
Incorrect, give it another shot!
The <style> tag is used for adding CSS internally in HTML, not for linking external CSS files.

Incorrect, give it another shot!

By using the <link> tag.
Correct Answer!
The <link> tag is used with the rel="stylesheet" and href="filename.css" attributes for linking external CSS files in the HTML file.
